carePlansIntro: Create, approve and activate bounded recurring care programs.
savedRefreshFailed: The server confirmed the change, but the latest view could not be loaded. Refresh before making another change.
clinicalWarning: Clinical instructions require an independently qualified reviewer to approve this exact immutable version.
revisionHint: A revision creates a new draft version. Approved and activated history remains unchanged.
approvalHint: Approval applies only to the displayed version and does not transfer to later revisions.
previewHint: Preview is read-only. Activation creates unassigned PLANNED visits, not confirmed appointments.
scheduledKept: Confirmed SCHEDULED visits are never silently cancelled by plan activation or disposition actions.
emptyPlans: No care plans match this filter.
generated: Activation completed. Review generated visits before assignment.
pauseDispositionHint: Pausing prevents normal assignment. Choose explicitly whether future unassigned planned visits remain or are cancelled.
cancelDispositionHint: Past visits remain. Choose explicitly whether future unassigned planned visits remain or are cancelled.
completeDispositionHint: Completion does not alter future visits. Resolve every future PLANNED or SCHEDULED visit first; the server will refuse completion otherwise.
resumeHint: Resuming makes the paused plan active again. It does not recreate visits cancelled while paused.
error: This action could not be completed. No success has been assumed.
denied: You cannot access this record or action in the current agency workspace.
stale: This record changed. Refresh before retrying.
validation: Review the required fields, state and date range.
scheduleConflict: Assignment conflicts with another confirmed visit or the travel buffer.
caregiverUnavailable: The caregiver is not eligible for this visit at commit time.
idempotencyConflict: This action key was already used for different data. Refresh and retry.
